description: This file defines a Java class 'SubscriptionActor' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It implements a custom actor that handles subscription commands, manages stream signals, and interacts with reactive stream subscribers, primarily used for managing subscriptions over a stream, including handling timeouts, cancellation, and forwarding data.

classes.name: SubscriptionActor
classes.description: Actor that translates subscription commands into stream operations and stream signals into subscription events, managing subscription lifecycle including timeouts, cancellation, and message forwarding.

classes.name: SubscriberOps
classes.description: Private static class implementing a reactive streams Subscriber<JsonArray> that forwards stream events to the associated SubscriptionActor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates a Props configuration for spawning a SubscriptionActor with specified idle timeout, sender, and headers.

methods.name: asSubscriber
methods.description: Wraps a SubscriptionActor reference as a reactive stream Subscriber<JsonArray>.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCreated
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionCreated event with the current subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: setSenderAndDittoHeaders
methods.description: Updates the sender and headers based on the received command.

methods.name: idleTimeout
methods.description: Handles the scenario when the actor times out due to inactivity, sending a timeout error and transitioning to zombie state.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription acknowledgment from the reactive stream, storing the subscription and notifying the creator.

methods.name: requestSubscription
methods.description: Handles demand requests for more data from the stream.

methods.name: cancelSubscription
methods.description: Cancels the current subscription and transitions the actor to zombie state.

methods.name: subscriptionHasNext
methods.description: Forwards received data to the sender.

methods.name: subscriptionComplete
methods.description: Handles stream completion by notifying the sender and transitioning to zombie state.

methods.name: subscriptionFailed
methods.description: Handles stream errors by notifying the sender and transitioning to zombie state.

methods.name: becomeZombie
methods.description: Transitions actor to zombie state, ignoring further messages for a specified lifetime.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the subscription based on actor's self-path name.
